content: To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to access specific details related to those plans. The information provided above is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. Please note that individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, you should contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
